info.title: myreach.top API
info.description: MyReach creator-page API. This reference covers the documented app and page-scoped agent API; it is not a catalog of internal admin, provider webhook, or operational routes. SESSION means the signed-in owner browser cookie; KEY means a revocable page-scoped key sent as Authorization: Bearer mr_live_…. A page key can access only its own page scope and cannot manage the account or API keys. Guide: https://myreach.top/ai-agents-guide. Base URL https://myreach.top (local development: http://localhost:8788). Errors return JSON with an error string unless noted. Agents can provision a temporary page with POST /api/agent/pages, build it with the returned key, then hand the claim URL to its intended owner for verified Google/email sign-in and explicit confirmation. Creation is limited to 2 pages per intended owner in a rolling 24 hours, including deleted pages. Remote public images are copied to durable MyReach storage on import/save and served locally. Conditional upstream checks occur on access after six hours; outages keep the last good copy. firstLesson.image is the left header icon; firstLesson.feature.image is a separate banner. Temporary pages stay private (public 404) until verified owner claim and publication. Private previews use the returned previewUrl. Claim confirmation requires the exact expectedRevision returned by claim inspection. Unclaimed pages are deleted after 24 hours; editing never renews expiry. MCP documentation: /ai-agents/mcp. The MCP protocol is documented separately from this REST schema.

post.summary: Provision a page before owner sign-in
post.description: Public bootstrap; no cookie or key needed. Accepts at most 8 KB. Returns a temporary page key and claimUrl once; save both securely. Limits: 2 creations per intended owner per rolling 24 hours (shared with owner POST /api/pages; deletion never refunds quota), 10 per network per 24 hours and 20 attempts per network per minute. Uses atomic shared storage. Limits deter bursts; rotating unverified emails and networks can bypass them. Temporary builders cannot upload private delivery files before ownership is claimed. Build with PUT /api/store?slug=...; then hand claimUrl to the owner. Normal account page caps apply at claim time (Free: 1, active Pro: 3). Unclaimed pages expire after 24 hours. A lost response cannot recover the key: retain responses and check slug conflicts before retrying.

post.summary: Claim and publish the reviewed revision after owner verification
post.description: Use the existing /login?claim=... screen. Requires an mr_session for the exact intended email authenticated with email code, magic link or verified Google email. Password sessions and API keys cannot claim. Owner must explicitly confirm. Normal account page limit applies. Confirmation is idempotent, makes the page permanent, and revokes the provisioning key. A new intended owner can complete claim sign-in even while general signup is waitlisted; the token alone never signs anyone in. The browser offers Link existing account and Create account and claim. New accounts are created only after verified sign-in with the account=new claim return path; confirmation links the already-built page and skips page creation onboarding. Accepts at most 8 KB, including chunked requests. Public content stays unavailable until this confirmation. Include expectedRevision from the current GET claim response. A stale revision returns 412; missing revision returns 428. Claim tokens permit status inspection after claim but never ongoing editing.

put.description: Replace the saved editable page snapshot for this slug. This is not a partial merge: read the current snapshot first, apply the requested changes, and include every editable slice you want to retain. Design, language, sections, social icon style, booking configuration, and cards live in this snapshot. Private delivery URLs and files are moved to private storage. A page key can modify only its own slug. Limits: page saves accept at most 2 MB and 30 writes per page per minute. API changes are reflected by active admin views. Owner browser saves must include If-Match; stale admin tabs cannot overwrite newer API edits.

A conflict returns 409; if storage or active calendar availability cannot be checked, it returns 503. Calendly bookings happen on Calendly and are not submitted here. Use /api/pay/create for paid booking checkout.

post.summary: Email the intended owner a claim button after the page is ready
post.description: Requires the original temporary provisioning key and its claim token. The server chooses the recipient from ownerEmail; agents cannot choose another recipient or email URL. Sends a branded Claim your page button. The owner chooses Link existing account or Create account and claim, verifies Google/email, then confirms. Account creation skips page onboarding. Maximum 4 claim emails per owner per rolling 24 hours. Delivery acceptance does not prove inbox receipt. Accepts at most 8 KB, including chunked requests.

get.description: Reads the origin home page metadata, including non-/favicon.ico icons. Redirects to the durable MyReach image cache when storage is configured. Platform/custom icon choices remain available.

parameters.name: theme
parameters.description: Background color scheme. Prefers the corresponding declared favicon over larger icons for the opposite scheme.

302.description: Redirect to the declared favicon or its cached local image URL. Cache-Control: public, max-age=3600.

502.description: Origin metadata unavailable and no saved metadata.

get.summary: Serve a durable local copy of a public remote image
get.description: Public image only, 5 MiB maximum actual bytes; accepts validated PNG/JPEG/WebP/AVIF/GIF/SVG/ICO content. DNS-pinned fetch rejects private targets and unsafe redirects. Uses existing STORE_KV metadata and FILES_BUCKET bytes; no TTL on last-good copies. On access after six hours, cached hits return immediately while background revalidation sends upstream ETag/Last-Modified validators. A 304 or identical content hash updates metadata only; changed bytes create a new cached object. Origin failures retain the last-good image and retry after 30 minutes. A fresh miss is negatively cached for five minutes. Never-cached images cannot be recovered during an origin outage. Re-import discovers replacement URLs when a website deployment changes hashed asset paths. SVG uses sandbox CSP and nosniff. Anonymous cold fills are capped at 60 per network per hour; cached hits and refreshes do not consume that budget.

200.description: Cached image bytes with SHA-256 ETag, Last-Modified, nosniff, sandbox CSP, and public cache headers.

502.description: No cached bytes and upstream image unavailable, unsupported or oversized.

503.description: Media storage or safe rate-limit service unavailable.

get.summary: Read website identity, socials and brand tokens
get.description: Public read-only website import. Returns profile name/bio/avatar, socialLinks, brand primary/secondary/font, favicon, pageTheme and found flags. Explicit semantic primary/secondary tokens take precedence over unrelated error/alert colors. Theme may be null when static source has no trustworthy active mode. With media storage configured, logo and favicon are copied locally and returned as absolute MyReach cache URLs. Map profile.bio to store profile.tagline; use the returned brand primary instead of forcing a preset color.

200.description: Website identity and brand suggestions; cached for up to six hours.

502.description: Website unavailable; no saved import response.

get.description: Uses the actual storefront renderer. Claim token grants private read access only. No-store, noindex, no-referrer. Optional revision pins the preview; changed revisions return 409. data=1 returns a sanitized JSON snapshot.

200.description: Private HTML preview or sanitized JSON.

platformAdmin.description: True when this account has platform-admin access.

pages.description: All non-demo page slugs owned by this account. Empty when the account has not chosen a page slug.

type.description: Current Store editor types include booking, product, ecourse, digital, webinar, coaching, membership, service, community, agent, email, lead, social, link, video, instagram, podcast, and blog. Legacy and future values remain forward-compatible.

image.description: Optional image URL for the card.

brandIcon.description: Optional automatic URL icon, built-in MyReach glyph or platform logo, website favicon, or named icon choice. The six-choice sets are social-custom-1…6, instagram-custom-1…6, whatsapp-custom-1…6, menu/menu-2…6, review/review-2…6, and location/location-2…6. Choice 6 in each set is an unframed SVG glyph in the theme text color; choices 1–5 use colorful artwork.

standalone.description: Display this booking or coaching card as an independent offer when supported.

calendarProvider.description: Card calendar artwork choice. The top-level Store calendarProvider selects the connected booking integration.

duration.description: Legacy booking duration in minutes; durationMin is preferred.

StoreCard.description: One Store card. The API keeps editable card-specific fields, including unknown forward-compatible fields. Public reads redact private delivery URLs and files; owner reads may include them.

StoreUpdate.description: Only recognized editable slices are saved; delivery links/files are moved to private storage.

firstLesson.description: Highlighted card: image + showIcon:true sets its small left header icon; desc is body text. feature.image is an independent optional large banner, with feature.imageFit cover/contain. cta + ctaHref + showCta:true sets the button; glow:true enables the light border. Remote public images are copied to durable media storage.

translations.description: Optional localized name, role, and quote keyed by language code.

secondaryLanguage.description: Legacy single-language field. Prefer secondaryLanguages; English remains primary.

languages.description: English plus up to two creator-selected additional languages. Activation copies existing English profile and card text into editable translations; rows stay shared.

secondaryLanguages.description: Up to two additional BCP 47 language codes; English remains primary.

translationSeeds.description: Language codes whose initial editable translations were seeded from English.

StoreSnapshot.description: Saved page snapshot. Older snapshots may contain additional legacy properties.

languages.description: Enabled languages: English and up to two additional BCP 47 language codes.

secondaryLanguage.description: Legacy first additional language code; use languages or secondaryLanguages for the full selection.

translations.description: Optional localized name, role, and quote keyed by language code.

secondaryLanguages.description: Enabled additional BCP 47 language codes; English remains primary.

translationSeeds.description: Language codes whose initial editable translations were seeded from English.

BookingInput.description: Use card with a numeric index or "fl" for the featured offer, or set fl:true. Name, email, date, and slot are required. The date and slot are local to the page calendar time zone. The slug is supplied in the query string.

AnalyticsInput.description: Only events with analyticsConsent:true are recorded; absent/false consent returns {ok:true,ignored:true}. Supported types are visit, click, and attention. Visits add aggregate source, country, device, browser, and platform counts; clicks add an item label, category, and coarse 5%-grid page coordinates; attention adds up to 15 active visible seconds. Raw IP addresses, full referrer URLs, and click URLs are not stored. Booking events are rejected because booking analytics are server-controlled.

attentionSeconds.description: Visible active seconds summed across consented visits.

PaymentConfigInput.description: Compatibility request only. Credential properties secretKey, publishableKey, webhookSecret and shopId are rejected.

PayCreateInput.description: Booking: provide card (numeric index or "fl") or fl:true, plus date and slot. Product/course: provide card.index and kind=product or course. In every case name and mail are required.

profileImage.description: Extracted Instagram or LinkedIn profile image; absent when the target is not a supported profile page or no image was found.

myreach.description: True when metadata came from a published MyReach page.

url.description: Public http(s) blog, article, RSS, Atom, or JSON Feed URL.

image.description: Preview image URL when available; may be an empty string.

feedUrl.description: Empty when the page-preview fallback was used.

redir.description: Local return path. The claim browser sets /login?claim=TOKEN&account=new when the owner chooses Create account and claim; existing accounts use account=existing. New claim accounts skip page creation onboarding.

sent.description: False only when a development code is returned.

devCode.description: Only returned by explicitly enabled development auth.

BookingAvailabilitySettings.description: Weekly availability for one booking offer, not continuous opening hours. Weekday values use JavaScript numbering: Sunday 0 through Saturday 6. Times are local start times in HH:mm format and use the page calendar time zone.

StoreSocial.description: A social profile link. iconStyle selects the MyReach SVG glyph or original network logo wherever this social appears.

iconStyle.description: svg uses the MyReach glyph in the page text color; logo uses the original network mark when available.

StoreDesign.description: Saved page presentation. Freestyle controls include layout, palette, background, outline, type, icon/header shape, desktop presentation, and per-layout button/card radii. Frozen theme presets supply and lock their own visual tokens. Custom pageBackground and outlineColor apply to freestyle layouts except Midnight. Cookie-consent and waitlist dialogs inherit the page theme; they have no separate design fields.

layout.description: Freestyle structural layout. windows8 is theme-driven; its frozen theme sets this layout automatically.

theme.description: Frozen theme preset identifier, or null for freestyle. GitHub and GitLab are available to human pages; all nine presets are available to agent and business pages.

accent.description: Named palette (green, teal, cyan, blue, indigo, navy, purple, pink, red, orange, amber, lime, terracotta, yaksebe, slate, black) or custom.

pageBackground.description: Optional custom page and surface background color.

outlineColor.description: Optional custom border and outline color.

desktopMode.description: desktop uses the wider desktop page presentation; mobile-first keeps the narrow mobile page column centered on desktop.

font.description: Freestyle font choices are inter, dm-sans, jakarta, and manrope. Other values are used by frozen themes or legacy snapshots.

buttonRadius.description: Legacy shared button radius; per-layout radius settings take precedence.

cardRadius.description: Legacy shared card radius; per-layout radius settings take precedence.

slots.description: Available local start times for the requested date.

DesignRadii.description: Per-layout radius overrides in pixels. Button values are 6–32; card values are 6–40.

StoreSection.description: A visible page section. Carousel presentation is shared across card, blog/article-feed, and testimonial carousels: the centered item is emphasized and neighboring items are dimmed.

translations.description: Localized section titles keyed by BCP 47 language code.

itemIndexes.description: Indexes into the Store items array; used by cards and carousel sections.

BlogFeedSnapshot.description: Saved public-feed discovery result and display controls for a blog card. Public URLs only; at most ten entries.

DesktopBackground.description: Optional desktop/tablet backdrop displayed outside the page sheet.

key.description: Temporary page-scoped bearer key, shown only once. Store securely. Revoked on owner confirmation.

claimUrl.description: Open in the intended owner browser. It is not a login session and cannot prove ownership by itself.

expiresAt.description: Unix seconds. Unclaimed page, claim URL and builder key expire at this time.

previewUrl.description: Private no-store preview. Public page returns 404 before claim.
